description: This file defines the 'Filter' controller class within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for handling events related to filtering products. It implements methods to add tasks for updating product info when filters are edited or deleted.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class handling product filter-related events, specifically for editing and deleting filters, and scheduling related tasks.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Handles the event after a filter is edited; loads products associated with a filter and schedules tasks to update their info.

methods.name: deleteFilter
methods.description: Handles the event after a filter is deleted; loads products associated with the filter and schedules tasks to update their info.
